def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (some values are text)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Fix out of range body_mass_g (5050000 is clearly an error, likely 5050)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric and fix negatives (flipper can't be negative)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    # Standardize sex column (strip whitespace)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip() if df['sex'].dtype == 'object' else df['sex']
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
